findings.title: Installation proceeds without verifying the installer when no integration exists
findings.body: When the installation webhook has not created an `Integration` yet, this branch advances the pipeline directly. The sender comparison below only runs for an already-existing integration, so the normal pipeline can create the integration from GitHub’s installation API without ever confirming that the OAuth-authenticated user matches the installer. Webhook delivery can be delayed or fail, allowing the account-mismatch check this change is intended to enforce to be bypassed.
